title: Payment webhooks are processed twice on retry
description:
# Payment webhooks are processed twice on retry

The handler is not idempotent, so a provider retry can mark an order paid twice. Harmless today because the second write is identical, wrong as soon as a webhook carries a partial capture.

title: Search index rebuilt from scratch every night
description:
# Search index rebuilt from scratch every night

Fine at 5,000 products; the full rebuild takes 40 minutes at 50,000. Switch to incremental updates before the catalog grows.
